item.tib: dbang bskur gter gyis phreng ba
item.coloph: de ltar phyi nang gsang ba'i dbang bskur gter gyi 'phreng (phreng) ba zhes bya ba/ zhi ba khol du phyung ba'i gsang dbang rdzogs s+ho/ stag la me 'bar gyi thugs bcud/ bla chen dran pa'i lung don/ stang chen dmu tsa'i man ngag/ phyi rabs las ldan gshen gyis spyod yul/ stang chen dmu tsa gyer med kyis/ dus mtha'i rnal 'byor bdag la snyan du brgyud/ bdag gis sbas dang gsang rgya thub par byas/ dad ldan grogs po'i rkyen gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ dkar chab (chag) yi ge ris su bris pa 'di/ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rnams la mthol lobashags/ bka' skyongs bsrung (srung) ma rnams la bzod par gsol/ dge bas 'gro kun rig 'dzin sa thob shog/
